subject.title: fix(memory-core): restore dreaming session ingestion for SQLite transcripts

question: Should this maintainer-labeled regression repair require redacted real SQLite runtime proof before it lands, rather than accepting the reported test-only evidence?
rationale: The patch affects persisted session identity across several Memory Core consumers, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling while the available evidence does not directly show the restored runtime outcome.

options.title: Require live SQLite proof
options.body: Request a redacted enabled-dreaming or QMD-export run that shows a SQLite session transcript is read and produces the expected corpus or export result before merge.

options.title: Accept focused test proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused regression suites as sufficient if they judge the existing test harness to exercise the production SQLite path adequately.

recommendation.title: Require live SQLite proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted enabled-dreaming or QMD-export run that shows a SQLite session transcript is read and produces the expected corpus or export result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties this person directly to the structured session-identity refactor and the affected Memory Core repair.
